revolver.name: REVOLVER
revolver.description: A six-shot revolver built around timing, recoil, and loaded-round order.

moves.name: FIRE
moves.description: Fire the next round. The revolver must finish its spin before it can fire again.

moves.name: RELOAD
moves.description: Reload missing normal rounds. Reloading also grants 15 temporary health and 25% damage reduction for 1 second.

moves.name: CHARGED LOAD
moves.description: At full charge, dump the cylinder and load six charged rounds with extreme recoil.

wand.name: WAND
wand.description: A light magic weapon that throws spinning stars with strange movement.

moves.name: STAR
moves.description: Fire a small spinning star that passes through walls.

moves.name: HOMING STARS
moves.description: Fire three small stars with slight homing. They fade away after a few seconds.

moves.name: BOUNCING STAR
moves.description: At full charge, fire a large star that ricochets once, then bursts into twelve smaller stars on its next wall impact.

sake.name: SAKE
sake.description: A difficult stance weapon built around drinking, spills, buffs, charge, and a dangerous drunk state.

moves.name: DRINK / GOURD THROW
moves.description: Drink once every 5 seconds. Each drink fills one of 8 drunk slots and grants one random buff. At 8 slots you automatically become drunk. While drunk, LMB throws the gourd and causes bleed.

moves.name: SAKE SPIT / SAKE SPILL / DRUNK SWING
moves.description: For 5 seconds after drinking, spit a messy fading cone from the fighter's body. Without a mouthful, spill sake and create a damaging slip puddle. While drunk, swing the gourd toward the nearest enemy.

moves.name: CHUG
moves.description: Chug only after at least 5 drinks, or when charge is full. Enter a 15 second drunk state with +50% damage, defense, movement, and jump strength. If full charge substitutes for the 5-drink requirement, the charge is consumed.

dagger.name: DAGGER
dagger.description: A fast mobility weapon built around short blinks, pressure from damage-over-time throws, and an 8 second cloak.

moves.name: BLINK
moves.description: Dash a short distance toward the cursor and damage enemies crossed by the dash. Leaves a 35% opacity trail. Cloak increases Blink distance and damage. 3 second cooldown.

moves.name: DAGGER THROW
moves.description: Throw the dagger and stick it into an enemy, applying damage over time for 3 seconds. While cloaked the projectile is faster and the damage-over-time lasts 6 seconds. 5 second cooldown.

moves.name: CLOAK
moves.description: Become translucent for 8 seconds. The first 4 seconds grant invulnerability frames, and Blink plus Dagger Throw are enhanced for the full cloak duration. 17 second cooldown.
